QuestInfo.name: [NLC] Street Sweeping
QuestInfo.0: Lita, the sheriff of NLC, seems not to fully trust in your abilities. Show her just how reliable you can be.
QuestInfo.1: Sheriff Lita asks you to prove your mettle by defeating Urban Fungus monsters, which have recently increased in number around the city. Defeat the troublesome Urban Fungus monsters, then return to Lita.
QuestInfo.2: You proved your competence to Lita.

mob.0: If you go out to the East side of the city, you'll see the place is full of them. Can you take out 200 for me?
